payload.walk:
Q1 REACHABILITY walked through the matrices - any part of the announcement fails, and the owner must still receive something actionable or the failure must be recorded. VERDICT: ADDRESSED, carried by se.adr-ladder-degrades-loudly and the I2 interface being optional by construction. The walk: E2 cannot fail outward by contract, so E3 always runs; E3's own failure is the only way nothing is sent, and F13 records it. AT-RISK RESIDUE, named honestly: if E3's publish fails, the owner receives nothing and only the record shows it - the scenario is satisfied by 'a recorded failure' rather than by delivery, which is the best any single channel can do. A second channel would be the only real answer, and that is deliberately out of scope.

The five stakeholder tensions walked as informal scenarios: rich-versus-protected ADDRESSED by encryption plus fragment-key, with the relay limit written into the ADR; silence-versus-reach ADDRESSED by announce-by-adjudicator; pointer-versus-page ADDRESSED by splitting the card from the brief; mockable-versus-tappable UNADDRESSED BY CONSTRUCTION and correctly so - it becomes D1, a real tap, because nothing in a matrix can settle it; free-tier-versus-expectation ADDRESSED by degradation, with its own tripwire.

UNADDRESSED, deliberately: content filtering by tier. The brief exports whatever the evidence holds, which is acceptable today and will not be later; recorded as se.raid-brief-exports-evidence-content rather than engineered now, because the filter needs kb's tiering to exist first.
payload.fitness_candidates:
Seven scenarios are measurable and should become automated checks at M7 rather than review-class judgements.

- FC1 every action URL is absolute: assert the published card's actions start with the configured base. This is the defect, and it is one line to check forever.
- FC2 the gate is marked: title, raised priority and the distinguishing tag present on a gate's card.
- FC3 the action budget holds: at most three actions, and when a brief exists the third is the view link.
- FC4 the stored object is ciphertext: publish a brief containing a unique marker, fetch the stored bytes, assert the marker is absent - the most valuable of the seven, because it is the one that would silently be wrong.
- FC5 nothing is announced before it serves: with a store that never becomes servable, assert no link is announced and the card still goes out.
- FC6 degradation is recorded: induce a publish failure, assert a card exists AND a recorded failure exists - the direct automation of Q1.
- FC7 silence when self-blessing: announce a gate the agent will self-bless, assert nothing is published.

All seven are cheap against an injected transport, which is what makes them fitness functions rather than aspirations - no live service is touched by the battery, exactly as i8 did with its mock. FC4 and FC6 guard the two properties that would otherwise fail silently.
